text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by reading error messages and testing different parts of the code. Good debugging tools, such as debuggers and breakpoints, help you find where problems happen. It is also important to follow a systematic approach: change one thing at a time and check the result before moving on. Logging is another useful strategy, because log messages show what the program is doing and help you understand where things go wrong. With patience and these simple methods, you can solve most problems effectively.
